name: coba-react-iot-dashboard
description: Root runner untuk menjalankan backend MQTT server dan React dashboard sekaligus.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n BACKEND,DASHBOARD -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix mqtt-server start" "npm --prefix dashboard/aircraft run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix mqtt-server install && npm --prefix dashboard/aircraft install
